question: Wang guessed tiles that can cover the plane must repeat. Was he right?
answer: Wang guessed that any set of tiles that covers the plane must repeat, but he was wrong. His student Robert Berger found a finite set of 20,426 tiles that covers the whole plane, but only without ever repeating. No slide of that set ever lands it back on itself.
move: A finite set of tiles can cover the endless plane and never repeat.

web.label: Two tiling patterns side by side, one repeating and one that never repeats. A see-through copy of a tile can be dragged over the pattern to check whether it lands exactly on itself again.

source: Veritasium, “The Infinite Pattern That Never Repeats” (YouTube, 2020)
